# ROS 2 MCP Server

> Universal Physical AI Coprocessor and Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway connecting 1,000+ AI models to ROS 2 robots with 3-tier execution sandboxing, fast-forward kinematic trajectory prediction, and 2D spatial LiDAR ASCII radar.

## Documentation
- [Comprehensive Overview](README.md): Architecture, supported AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity), and 60-second quickstart.
- [Architecture Blueprint](ARCHITECTURE.md): JSON-RPC stdio transport, thread-safe message queues, and rclpy daemon integration.
- [System Diagnostics](README.md#system-diagnostic-check-doctor): Built-in CLI doctor diagnostics and environment verification.

## Architecture & Key Concepts
- [3-Tier Execution Sandbox](README.md#3-tier-execution-sandbox-guardrails): READ_ONLY, SAFE_WRITE, and FULL execution guardrails with mutex-guarded audit logging.
- [Kinematic Trajectory Predictor](README.md#%EF%B8%8F-predictive-simulation--safety-verification-architecture): 1000Hz fast-forward kinematic forward simulation (<0.1ms compute).
- [Spatial ASCII Radar](README.md#%EF%B8%8F-predictive-simulation--safety-verification-architecture): 360-degree LiDAR pointcloud translation to 2D text-based spatial grid.
- [Predictive Neural Safety](README.md#%EF%B8%8F-predictive-simulation--safety-verification-architecture): Real-time parameter clamping with Routh-Hurwitz stability proof.

## Tools & APIs
- [Tool Reference](README.md#complete-16-tool-catalog): 16 standard MCP tools spanning topics, parameters, PID tuning, trajectory simulation, and swarm coordination.

## Optional
- [Performance Benchmarking](docs/BENCHMARKS.md): Sub-millisecond latency (<0.08ms) and O(1) tool dispatch benchmarks.
- [Predictive Safety Architecture](docs/PREDICTIVE_SAFETY_ARCHITECTURE.md): Configurations for Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, Windsurf, and Antigravity IDE.
- [Automated Verification Suite](tests/): 42-test simulation-mode test suite verifying protocol and sandbox invariants.
